question: What claim is being made here about a teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters?
premises: The earth-moving good-eaters are in question.
A teaching concerning them was told.
It was told by an earth-mover.
inference: A teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover, O beloved.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: By an earth-mover, O beloved, a teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told.
